review_scope: All40 provider-ID-resolved frozen rows; four source cells visually read against official scans on27 physical PDF pages. Remaining602 data rows not independently cell-verified in this review.
visual_method: Official PDF rendered with PyMuPDF at1.8scale; first56% of landscape page contains provider, type, served settlement, attached population and planned capacity. Seven contact sheets manually inspected. OCR/transcription used for navigation only.

header_population_cell_literal: Численность населения в обслуживаемых населенных пунктах, закрепленных по участковому принципу (прикрепленное)
scope_conclusion: Named served-settlement labels do not certify every resident is assigned. Provider street/house address does not restrict origin to those houses. Household registry items cannot be promoted into whole-NP medical centers/attachments. City hospital/child-consultation totals can cover population subsets. All10 nonhousehold resolved records are local; no independent intersettlement destination test is supported by this resolved subset.
